framework: FBISE Assessment Framework (National Curriculum of Pakistan 2022-23)
subject: Pakistan Studies

source.publisher: Federal Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education
source.licence: Government publication; structure + our own wording only

outcomes.text: Analyse the parts of Pakistan's ideology, including equal rights for minorities.
Analyse the Two-Nation Theory, how it began and why it mattered.
Identify the first problems the new state faced: borders, refugees, constitution and administration.
Explain how well Pakistan handled its early challenges.
Evaluate the first Prime Minister's leadership and its political, social and economic effects.
Critically analyse Pakistan's ruling periods from 1958 to 2022 and their effects.
Critically analyse causes and effects of the wars with India.
Analyse social, political and economic effects of the war in Afghanistan on Pakistan.
Locate Pakistan on the world map and assess its geopolitical and economic importance.
Analyse Pakistan's strategic importance in South and Central Asia and its effect on development.
Investigate Pakistan's geography, climate and vegetation using maps and geospatial tools.
Use geographic tools to study forest types, productive and protective, with benefits and uses.
Investigate factors affecting irrigated plantations and mangroves and their role in disaster protection.
Tell deforestation from afforestation, assess its effects and propose sustainable solutions.
Examine climate change effects, severe weather and human actions that raise environmental risk.
Analyse factors behind global warming and their link to floods and other hazards.
Recognise ways to reduce climate change and the damage from floods and droughts.
Evaluate fossil fuel impacts on climate and the NDMA's disaster management role.
Describe main freshwater sources and develop solutions to water problems.

units.title: Domain C: Resources and Development of Pakistan

outcomes.text: Describe types and locations of minerals and their role in industry and economy.
Investigate Pakistan's mining industry, its uses, challenges and environmental protection.
Assess hydro, wind, solar and biofuel energy and weigh their advantages and disadvantages.
Recognise principal industries, their distribution, challenges and economic, environmental and social effects.
Analyse pros and cons of industries and the effect of government policy, including industrial estates and zones.
Analyse underemployment and the role of literacy and skills training in development.
Understand animal husbandry and fish farming and what makes each distinct.
Investigate obstacles in livestock raising and propose sustainable practices.
Assess the economic effect of fish farming and projects such as Gwadar, CPEC and the coastal highway.
Evaluate fish farming's economic prospects and how infrastructure supports sustainable fisheries.
Evaluate how machines, email and the internet support education, industry, services and e-commerce.
Evaluate overall technology impact on society, business and its possible harms.
Analyse telecommunications challenges, especially for education, and growth potential.
Explain the significance of individuals in national development.
List the limits of individual effort and why supporting measures matter for progress.
Acknowledge how shared cultural, religious and ethnic identities support a peaceful society.
Evaluate the Quaid's vision of religious freedom.
Compare the state's role in equality, equity and justice for gender, religion and class.
Examine factors that block these processes in Pakistan.
Acknowledge tourism's significance and describe natural, religious and commercial destinations.
Assess tourism challenges and measures to develop it.
Analyse tourism's importance to a local area and the country's economy.
Discuss the main features of the 1973 Constitution, Islamic provisions and major amendments.
Infer the responsibilities of a good citizen and women's rights under the constitution.
Explain the federal structure of Pakistan's government.
Analyse the UN Declaration of Human Rights against Islamic principles, covering child rights, gender and animal protection.
Recognise the significance of self-sufficiency for national development.
Evaluate the conditions of women and measures to end problems in some industries.
Evaluate Pakistan's progress on the SDGs and UN Agenda 2030 measures.

units.title: Domain F: Pakistan and World Affairs

outcomes.text: Review current foreign policy, its determinants and effect on ties with major countries and blocs.
Examine relations with Russia and predict future prospects.
Analyse the Kashmir conflict and its effect on Pak-India relations.
Criticise Pak-US relations before and after a key turning point.
Elaborate the UN's role on human rights, peacekeeping, food, health, education and poverty.
Critically review Pakistan's role in regional organisations such as the EU and ECO.
Discuss how global monetary institutions, especially the IMF, assist Pakistan.
